$comment: Effective-order tables and XML writer rules. Contract f1-extensions/1. F7 delegates to moddle-xml 12.3.1; no adapter adds an XML sorting policy. Attribute source order is excluded from preservation; intra-property array order (extensionElements.values, $children, other containment arrays) is preserved; inter-property source interleaving is not reconstructed.
zone: Effective descriptor order governs XML child order for registered properties: attributes first (descriptor filter order), then contained properties in effective-descriptor order. Generic attributes and declarations follow the writer's existing generic-attribute/declaration handling; escaping, format and preamble behaviour are the native writer's own.
referenceImplementation: bpmn-moddle 10.3.1 / moddle-xml 12.3.1, verified through tests/oracle/f1_references.mjs descriptorOrder against the pinned packages.
writerRules: Prefix reuse, generation, counters, collision suffixes, scope and declaration placement follow the literal writer exactly; vectors freeze reuse, generation, occupied-prefix collision, same-URI aliases, local rebinding, default reset and known-package declaration placement.
The xml prefix is never declared; its URI is fixed.
Comparator rule: changed retained QName/URI/value/body/child order is a preservation failure; attribute-order-only differences are not; CDATA versus text is not a tree distinction.
Every native loss of lexical information (comments, processing instructions, discarded whitespace, CDATA boundaries, mixed-text interleaving) is visible as a diagnostic, never silent.
